### Packages

```{r setup}
library(arrow)
library(gtsummary)
library(R.utils)
library(tidyverse)
library(comorbidity)
library(grDevices)
library(tidymodels)
library(FSelectorRcpp)
library(bigrquery)
library(GGally)
library(ranger)
library(xgboost)
library(glmnet)
library(doParallel)
library(finetune)
library(ggplot2)
```

### Token Set up and DB connection

```{r}
# path to the service account token
satoken <- "biostat-203b-2026-winter-92fefbfab477.json"
# BigQuery authentication using service account
bq_auth(path = satoken, cache = FALSE)

con_bq <- dbConnect(
  bigrquery::bigquery(),
  project = "biostat-203b-2025-winter",
  dataset = "mimiciv_3_1",
  billing = "biostat-203b-2025-winter"
)
con_bq
```

```{r}
# load BigQuery tables
icu <- tbl(con_bq, "icustays")
patients <- tbl(con_bq, "patients")
diagnosis <- tbl(con_bq, "diagnoses_icd")
d_diagnosis <- tbl(con_bq, "d_icd_diagnoses")
```
